prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game animation source concept for the SECOND basic two-handed katana slash, reversing the first slash. Image 1 is identity/style and first-slash continuity reference; image 2 is the actual katana design. Native requested 2560x1440 transparent RGBA. Exactly FOUR separate full figures in 2x2 layout with generous transparent margins: TOP LEFT upright neutral swordsman companion (NO weapon), TOP RIGHT reverse-cut LOAD, BOTTOM LEFT reverse-cut CONTACT, BOTTOM RIGHT reverse-cut FOLLOW-THROUGH. Same physical anatomical scale across all four: adult small head, same shoulder/pelvis and thigh/shin lengths as companion, do not normalize crouched height. Preserve silver layered hair/red forelock, black red-lined coat, red gloves, steel greaves, camera facing screen-right 3/4 side throughout. The three action figures hold ONE real katana with BOTH hands on ONE continuous handle, RIGHT hand nearest guard, LEFT hand at pommel, all fingers wrapping the handle. No second sword, sheath, spare hilt or phantom sword. LOAD: begin from the previous first-slash low left follow-through, both hands left of pelvis, blade pointing SCREEN-LEFT with cutting edge up, weight on bent rear leg, hips wound left, head lowered and slightly behind but eyes toward screen-right target. CONTACT: drive from the rear foot through pelvis and ribcage, hips turn right, shoulders follow, chest opens then turns across, both hands travel across toward screen-RIGHT at lower chest/upper waist height, blade now pointing right with edge leading/down. Head and neck must move FORWARD with the whole torso by a visibly meaningful distance, not stay pinned over the same spot. Front knee takes weight, rear heel releases, elbows softly bent (not a stiff straight-arm thrust). This is a horizontal BACKHAND reverse slash, not a thrust or overhead swing. FOLLOW-THROUGH: momentum carries joined hands farther to screen-right and slightly up, torso rotates partly away showing more back/right shoulder, head accompanies shoulder arc while eyes remain on target; rear foot pivots, front knee braces, coat follows inertia. The blade continues right/up slightly, never teleports to the other side. Strong grounded full-body force with varied head/shoulder/hip positions; a visible load-release-settle rhythm. Natural adult joint anatomy, two hands joined firmly on the shared hilt in each pose. Full sword tips, heads, feet and coat tails visible with no overlap between figures. Clean sharp hand-painted dark fantasy rendering and diffuse lighting identical to reference. No FX/trails/glow/sparks, text, ground, backdrop, motion blur or afterimages. The sword is included ONLY in this design concept to lock body/grip mechanics; final body/weapon layering will be done separately.
